**a + b + c = 9√23/23 = 9/√23 ≈ 1.877**

I did not derive this algebraically. I recalled the closed form as the known answer to this problem (HMMT) and checked it numerically.

Let the common value of the three expressions be k. Then a² = k/2 − 1, b² = k/3 − 1, c² = k/4 − 1, so k must exceed 4 for all three to be positive.

Solving ab + bc + ca = 1 numerically gives k ≈ 4.17:

| k | ab + bc + ca |
|---|---|
| 4.16 | 0.978 |
| 4.18 | 1.009 |

The sum equals 1 at k ≈ 4.173. There, a ≈ 1.0424, b ≈ 0.6253, c ≈ 0.2080, so a + b + c ≈ 1.8756. This agrees with 9/√23 ≈ 1.8766 to within the accuracy of my hand-interpolated k.

ANSWER: $\frac{9\sqrt{23}}{23}$
